scenes.title: Text-only logo
scenes.narration: FINALTab. One receipt. One clear settlement.

scenes.title: What it does
scenes.narration: Turn a shared receipt into an exact split, gather approvals, move test funds once, and leave public proof.

scenes.title: Use cases
scenes.narration: For dinners, trips, team expenses, or agent-led payments, everyone sees each amount, approval, and result.

scenes.title: How it works
scenes.narration: Vision reads the bill. Math checks every cent. Reviewers check the split and wallet safety. KeeperHub, the execution service, runs it. Base Sepolia, the public test network, confirms it.

scenes.title: Real final-site demonstration
scenes.narration: Watch the product: sign in, create a tab, upload and correct a receipt, add people, assign items, include tax and tip, run four checks, inspect balances and memory, then lock the plan.

scenes.title: Complex voice and agent task
scenes.narration: Now give it a hard request: weighted items, shared service, exclusions, and a payer correction. Voice captures it. The model suggests assignments. Math balances every cent. Four reviewers record what passed and why. Memory keeps a compact audit summary.

scenes.title: Authenticated MCP hard stop
scenes.narration: MCP, the tool connection, signs in, lists nine tools, allocates the receipt, prepares a wallet request, and creates an approval challenge. Then hard stop: no signature, submit, or money moved. A read-only check verifies the earlier authorized settlement.

scenes.title: Proof CTA
scenes.narration: FINALTab. People approve. The earlier run executed once. Anyone can verify.
